How this site was built

  1. Original Era archive

    From a gaming homepage

    The archive repository’s first commit dates to September 2024. The April 2026 snapshot shows the site’s dark gaming layout, animated FN branding, Minecraft server pages and feedback page.

    The archive retains its historical wording and artwork. Use the current FN SMP guide for joining and connection information.

    Browse the archiveCommit history
  2. Official FN Squad site

    Into a community hub

    The current GitHub repository began in October 2026. It brought FreakyNews, FN SMP and community links together under the FN Squad name, using the monochrome FN identity, light and dark modes, and a frosted, floating menu.

    The following updates added cleaner URLs, an official links directory and source links for FreakyNews.

    Explore the public repository
  3. Liquid Glass redesign

    A clearer way to explore

    The redesign builds on the frosted menu with a Liquid Glass header and controls that work in both themes. It reworks the mobile menu and social directory, with clearer paths to news, Minecraft and community help.

    FreakyNews search and topic filters run in the browser. Saved links to the old page URLs lead to the new pages.

    Explore FreakyNewsSee official community links

Under the hood

A small Python build script generates the static HTML from shared templates. CSS shapes the responsive layout and glass effects. JavaScript handles the menu, theme switch and news filters. Fonts and logos are served with the site, and the public build is packaged for GitHub Pages.

Mengenali FN Squad

FN Squad ialah komuniti permainan video dan kumpulan pencipta kandungan bebas yang berpangkalan di Malaysia. Kami mengendalikan FN SMP dan FreakyNews serta berhubung melalui WhatsApp dan Discord.

Laman asal bermula sebagai laman permainan. Kini, FN Squad menghimpunkan FreakyNews, FN SMP dan pautan komuniti dalam reka bentuk Liquid Glass. Lihat arkib laman asal.
